response.justification: The candidate is a highly experienced full-stack/backend engineer with strong TypeScript, Node.js, and DLang expertise, but has only brief, dated C++ exposure (2014-2015 at National Instruments) and no evidence of the core requirements: modern C++/STL architecture work, message brokers, MQTT/REST for IoT, IEC 62443 SDL practices, or industrial protocols. The role requires a senior C++ architect for industrial automation/IoT platforms, which is a fundamental mismatch with this candidate's current skill set and recent trajectory.
strengths: 15+ years of broad, high-quality software engineering experience across many domains
Demonstrated technical leadership, mentoring, and workshop/training delivery
Experience with distributed systems, async I/O, multi-threading, and high-performance apps (in DLang, not C++)
concerns: No current or recent C++ experience — last C++ work was ~10 years ago and appears minor
No evidence of IEC 62443, SDL, or industrial cybersecurity experience
No mention of MQTT, message brokers, industrial protocols (Modbus, OPC UA, IEC 61850, etc.) or IoT platform architecture

key_factors.factor: No IoT/MQTT/message-broker or industrial protocol experience
